products.name: SambaNova
products.note: Enterprise AI hardware+software; DataScale platform; on-prem deployment; sovereign AI

reading.body:
SambaNova Systems builds custom hardware and orchestration software for running large language models inside enterprise data centers, positioning itself as an alternative to cloud-based AI inference for companies that want to keep models on-premises.

The company's strategy centers on dataflow processing units, or RDUs, which it argues are more efficient than general-purpose processors for frontier-scale models. This matters for the compute constraint because RDU efficiency directly affects how much inference throughput a given physical installation can deliver. SambaNova pairs this hardware with software that manages deployment across multiple nodes and switches between different models, allowing customers to run different frontier-scale models on a single cluster without redesigning infrastructure. The sovereign AI offering extends this logic geographically, partnering with national operators to run open-source models within country borders.

The data confirms JPMorganChase as a customer for on-premises inference, but does not reveal the scale of deployment, the power consumption of RDU clusters, or whether SambaNova has announced new data center facilities to support growth. It also does not specify which frontier-scale models run on RDUs, the cost per inference compared to cloud alternatives, or market share against GPUs and other specialized inference hardware. The funding history and valuation are recorded, but the data does not cover burn rate, revenue, or competitive wins and losses.

profile_text.body:
SambaNova Systems is a Palo Alto company founded in 2017 that describes itself as a complete AI platform for inference, fine-tuning, and agentic AI, built to integrate into existing data center infrastructure. Its site points to dataflow technology and a memory architecture as the basis for the performance it claims on large AI models, and it markets the platform as spanning agents, models, knowledge, and data.

The company's own product names include SambaStack, which it says switches between multiple frontier-scale models so agentic workflows can run end to end on one node, and SambaOrchestrator, for managing model deployments and scaling across data centers. It says frontier open-weight models are optimized to run on RDUs, its own processor line, without a separate engineering project per model. SambaNova also describes a network of sovereign AI data center partners that run its platform within national borders, and positions the offering as composable and open, unifying structured and unstructured data and deploying on any AI model.

The company is tracked here as an enterprise AI hardware and software product in the chat and general LLM category, with the DataScale platform, on-premises deployment, and sovereign AI noted as its focus. No litigation, MCP servers, or SEC and patent facts are recorded for it.
